dct_description_sm: This data set is cross sectional data from a sample of 165 Canadians collected using an on-line survey during the COVID-19 pandemic (November 2020 to February 2021). The survey used time use diary methods to capture activity patterns and measures of well-being.
dct_title_s: COVID-19: How are we managing? Time use and well-being during the COVID-19 crisis
